title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第十九章、掉脑袋的勇气

    王铁告诉包拯，火灾那晚高小山放出宫的宫女和太监是楚珠和马超。因为这件事，高小山被张怀杀了。
    “小山是个善良的人，不管是什么原因，我都相信他做的事一定是对的。都怪我，没有勇气、也没有能力帮他，让他不明不白地死了这么多年。今天如果不是包大人您来找我，我还不知道要等到什么时候才能把小山的冤屈说出来。我对不起小山！”王铁哭着说，他拉着包拯的手跪下来请求道：“包大人，大家都说您是天底下最公正无私的人，请您一定要还小山一个清白！”
    包拯扶起他，重重地点头：“我明白，请放心。”
    这是今天第二次说“请放心”，第一次是对侍卫营里那个老兵说的，第二次是现在对王铁说的，都是为了一个叫高小山的人。高小山，这个名字在包拯心里变得像大山一样高大起来。
    离开王铁家，包拯和公孙策骑马走在街上，两个人都是心事重重的样子。
    “火灾现场少的两具女尸，如果其中一个是楚珠，那另一个是谁？楚珠和马超为什么要带着一个食盒出宫？食盒……食盒里面装了什么吗？”包拯边走边说。
    “包拯。”公孙策站住了，他望着包拯的背影，眼里满是担心。
    “怎么了？”包拯回头看他。
    “这一次，你就听我的，好吗？回宫把令牌还给皇上，不要再查了。”
    很少听到公孙策这样请求地说话，他一直都是骄傲的。“你怕了？”包拯笑问道。
    “我公孙策什么时候怕过了？我是担心你！你知道你要查的人是谁吗？张怀！他是太后的人！你查他就是查太后啊！”公孙策又气又急地骂道。
    “我知道，怎么了？”
    “怎么了？太后！皇帝的母亲！就算你把案子查清了，你也会掉脑袋的！”
    “哈哈哈……你都不怕，我怕什么？掉脑袋就掉脑袋，但案子是一定要查的！”包拯大笑着往前跑了，声音再远远地飘回来：“公孙策，快跟上来，我们去太医院！”
    公孙策摇头叹了一口气，踢踢马肚子，跟了上去。
    皇帝给的令牌真有用，真的没人阻拦他们了。只要包拯把令牌往前一举，任何拦在前面的人都低头让开了路。他们顺利地进了宫，一路走到了太医院。
    “太医院的资料我已经看过了，还来这儿做什么？”公孙策问。
    “我想看看还有没有什么线索，抓张怀需要证据。”包拯说。
fullText.traditional:
第十九章、掉腦袋的勇氣

    王鐵告訴包拯，火災那晚高小山放出宮的宮女和太監是楚珠和馬超。因為這件事，高小山被張懷殺了。
    “小山是個善良的人，不管是什麼原因，我都相信他做的事一定是對的。都怪我，沒有勇氣、也沒有能力幫他，讓他不明不白地死了這麼多年。今天如果不是包大人您來找我，我還不知道要等到什麼時候才能把小山的冤屈說出來。我對不起小山！”王鐵哭著說，他拉著包拯的手跪下來請求道：“包大人，大家都說您是天底下最公正無私的人，請您一定要還小山一個清白！”
    包拯扶起他，重重地點頭：“我明白，請放心。”
    這是今天第二次說“請放心”，第一次是對侍衛營裡那個老兵說的，第二次是現在對王鐵說的，都是為了一個叫高小山的人。高小山，這個名字在包拯心裡變得像大山一樣高大起來。
    離開王鐵家，包拯和公孫策騎馬走在街上，兩個人都是心事重重的樣子。
    “火災現場少的兩具女屍，如果其中一個是楚珠，那另一個是誰？楚珠和馬超為什麼要帶著一個食盒出宮？食盒……食盒裡面裝了什麼嗎？”包拯邊走邊說。
    “包拯。”公孫策站住了，他望著包拯的背影，眼裡滿是擔心。
    “怎麼了？”包拯回頭看他。
    “這一次，你就聽我的，好嗎？回宮把令牌還給皇上，不要再查了。”
    很少聽到公孫策這樣請求地說話，他一直都是驕傲的。“你怕了？”包拯笑問道。
    “我公孫策什麼時候怕過了？我是擔心你！你知道你要查的人是誰嗎？張懷！他是太后的人！你查他就是查太后啊！”公孫策又氣又急地罵道。
    “我知道，怎麼了？”
    “怎麼了？太后！皇帝的母親！就算你把案子查清了，你也會掉腦袋的！”
    “哈哈哈……你都不怕，我怕什麼？掉腦袋就掉腦袋，但案子是一定要查的！”包拯大笑著往前跑了，聲音再遠遠地飄回來：“公孫策，快跟上來，我們去太醫院！”
    公孫策搖頭嘆了一口氣，踢踢馬肚子，跟了上去。
    皇帝給的令牌真有用，真的沒人阻攔他們了。只要包拯把令牌往前一舉，任何攔在前面的人都低頭讓開了路。他們順利地進了宮，一路走到了太醫院。
    “太醫院的資料我已經看過了，還來這兒做什麼？”公孫策問。
    “我想看看還有沒有什麼線索，抓張懷需要證據。”包拯說。

sentences.traditional: 只要包拯把令牌往前一舉，任何攔在前面的人都低頭讓開了路。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào bāo zhěng bǎ lìng pái wǎng qián yì jǔ rèn hé lán zài qián miàn de rén dōu dī tóu ràng kāi le lù
sentences.english: As long as Bao Zheng raised the token, anyone blocking the way would bow their heads and step aside.

sentences.simplified: 他们顺利地进了宫，一路走到了太医院。
sentences.traditional: 他們順利地進了宮，一路走到了太醫院。
sentences.pinyin: tā men shùn lì de jìn le gōng yí lù zǒu dào le tài yī yuàn
sentences.english: They smoothly entered the palace and made their way to the Imperial Medical Institute.

sentences.simplified: “太医院的资料我已经看过了，还来这儿做什么？”公孙策问。
sentences.traditional: “太醫院的資料我已經看過了，還來這兒做什麼？”公孫策問。
sentences.pinyin: tài yī yuàn de zī liào wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guò le hái lái zhè‘r zuò shén me gōng sūn cè wèn
sentences.english: “I have already looked at the records of the Imperial Medical Institute. What are we doing here again?” Gongsun Ce asked.

sentences.traditional: “我想看看還有沒有什麼線索，抓張懷需要證據。”包拯說。

sentence_translations: Chapter 19: The Courage to Lose One’s Head
Wang Tie told Bao Zheng ..
.. that the palace maid and eunuch who were let out of the palace on the night of the fire were Chu Zhu and Ma Chao.
Because of this matter, Gao Xiaoshan was killed by Zhang Huai.
“Xiaoshan was a kind-hearted person. No matter what the reason, I always believed that what he did was right.
It’s all my fault. I didn’t have the courage or the ability to help him, and he died unjustly many years ago.
If it weren’t for you coming to see me today, Lord Bao, ..
.. I don’t know how much longer I would have had to wait to speak out about Xiaoshan’s injustice.
I’ve let Xiaoshan down!” Wang Tie said, crying.
He grabbed Bao Zheng’s hand and knelt down to plead:
“Lord Bao, everyone says you are the most just and impartial person in this world. Please, you must get justice for Xiaoshan!”
Bao Zheng helped him up and nodded firmly, “I understand, please rest assured.”
That was the second time that day he said, “Please rest assured.”
The first time was to the old soldier in the guard camp, and the second time was now to Wang Tie, both for a person named Gao Xiaoshan.
Gao Xiaoshan—this name grew as towering as a mountain in Bao Zheng’s heart.
Leaving Wang Tie’s house, Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce rode their horses down the street, both looking deeply worried.
“Two female bodies were missing from the scene of the fire. If one of them was Chu Zhu, then who was the other one?
Why did Chu Zhu and Ma Chao leave the palace with a food box?
Food box … What was inside the food box?” Bao Zheng said as he rode.
“Bao Zheng.” Gongsun Ce stopped and looked at Bao Zheng’s back, his eyes full of concern.
“What’s wrong?” Bao Zheng turned to look at him.
“This time, listen to me, okay?
Return to the palace and give the token back to the emperor. Don’t investigate any further.”
It was rare to hear Gongsun Ce speak in such a pleading manner. He had always been proud.
“Are you scared?” Bao Zheng asked with a smile.
“When have I, Gongsun Ce, ever been scared? I am worried about you!
Do you know who you are investigating? Zhang Huai! He is the empress dowager’s man!
Investigating him is like investigating the empress dowager!” Gongsun Ce scolded angrily and anxiously.
“I know, what about it?”
“What about it? The empress dowager! The emperor’s mother! Even if you solve the case, you will lose your head!”
“Hahaha … If you’re not afraid, why should I be?
Lose my head if I must, but the case must be investigated!”
Bao Zheng laughed heartily and ran forward, his voice drifting back from afar:
“Gongsun Ce, hurry up and follow me. We’re going to the Imperial Academy of Medicine!”
Gongsun Ce shook his head and sighed, kicked the horse’s belly, and followed.
The token given by the emperor really worked. No one stopped them anymore.
As long as Bao Zheng raised the token, anyone blocking the way would bow their heads and step aside.
They smoothly entered the palace and made their way to the Imperial Medical Institute.
“I have already looked at the records of the Imperial Medical Institute. What are we doing here again?” Gongsun Ce asked.
“I want to see if there are any more clues. We need evidence to catch Zhang Huai,” Bao Zheng said.
